commands.command: cargo test -p quansio-qworkerd  # 85 passed, 0 failed, against a real headless Google Chrome 154.0.8037.93 (+ python3/openssl for a real HTTPS server with a self-signed certificate). New suites: browser_fencing (5), browser_ledger (6), browser_secrets (8), browser_guard (15), browser_contract (3), plus 20 unit tests; EXEC-009's browser suite (5) still passes. Proves: a stale revision/snapshot/capture/fingerprint/hit test never clicks (server-side hit counts), an in-doubt action is not retried (real unacknowledged click, redelivery, restart), secrets never in model context/journal/digests and refused outside the allow-list (top and target frame), plain text refused in password/one-time-code/card fields, dialogs fence, downloads are bounded, permissions denied, certificate errors wait for a user, agent input is not a gesture

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<private database> cargo test -p quansio-machine --test browser --test browser_guard  # 12 passed against real PostgreSQL: the guard report is parsed strictly and stored on the session row; only a user decides a certificate or grants camera/microphone, an agent actor leaves the row byte-for-byte unchanged, a report cannot undo a decision; a placeholder resolves through the secret broker's own handles scoped to browser.type and the value is in no stored column

cargo test -p quansio-tools  # browser tool declarations: every browser tool declares a side-effect class that agrees with config/effects.yaml, no selector-only mutating tool, a lowered tier or missing class is refused, idempotency keys move with snapshot/ref/revision
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<private database> cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast  # 990 passed, 0 failed across 150 suites
python3 mutation-checks.py (in this bundle; paths are this worktree's)  # 29 mutants of the guards, every one COMPILES and every one KILLED by a named test after CONTROL-PASSED on the unmutated suite
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings  # clean
python3 scripts/validate_v81.py; scripts/ci/arch_check.py; workspace_check.py; inventory.py --scan; check_authority.py --check; legacy_map_check.py; supply_chain/check.py  # all CLEAN / PASS

uv run --project python pytest tests/architecture tests/contract tests/ci  # 238 passed (test_generated_bindings_are_current deselected: the Rust contract generator cannot run from a worktree under .claude/worktrees; verified by the external-checkout ci.sh run)
cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run && tsc --noEmit; npx eslint apps/desktop  # 136 passed (41 e2e skipped: they need a built server), typecheck and eslint clean
